Q6111.reason: The content-neutral littering ordinance serves an important public interest and validly regulates expressive conduct without targeting communication.

Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove a state-court action, so the plaintiff’s removal requires remand of the entire case.

Q5651.reason: The “as is” clause excludes implied warranties but does not negate the express warranty created by describing the car as a 1964 Thunderbird.
